chunks: My father (rah) said: Sa'd ibn Abdillah narrated to me, who said: Ahmad ibn al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated to me from Uthman ibn Isa from some of his companions from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Allah did not create any creature except that He made for it a dwelling in Paradise and a dwelling in Hell. When the people of Paradise are settled in Paradise and the people of Hell in Hell, a caller will call: O people of Paradise, look down. So they will look down at the Hellfire, and their dwellings in Hell will be raised for them. Then it will be said to them: These are your dwellings which you would have entered had you disobeyed your Lord. If one were to die of joy, the people of Paradise would die of joy that day from what was averted from them of punishment. Then they will be called: O assembly of the people of Hell, lift your heads and look at your dwellings in Paradise. So they will lift their heads and look at their dwellings and what is in them of bliss. Then it will be said to them: These are your dwellings which you would have entered had you obeyed your Lord. He said: If one were to die of grief, the people of Hell would die of grief that day. So these will inherit the dwellings of these, and these will inherit the dwellings of these. And that is the saying of Allah, the Exalted: 'Those are they who are the heirs. They who inherit Al-Firdaus (the highest level of Paradise); they therein shall abide eternally.'
ai.seo_question: What happens to the dwellings of Paradise and Hell for those who enter the opposite realm?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A’mal* elaborates on the eschatological concept of *Warathah* (inheritance of dwellings), where the inhabitants of Paradise and Hell witness the homes they forfeited or earned due to their obedience or disobedience. It highlights the psychological dimension of divine justice, where the joy of the saved and the sorrow of the damned are intensified by this visual confirmation of their fate, directly linking to the Quranic verse 13:35 regarding the inheritance of Paradise.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. My father (rah) said: it was narrated to me by Sa’d b. Abdillah who said it was narrated to me by Ahmad b. al-Hussain b. Sa’eed from Uthman b. Isa from some of his companions from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) said:

“The Almighty Allah has created a house in Paradise as well as in Hell for each and every creature. When the people of Paradise and Hell go to their respective houses, a call will be given out: O people of Paradise! Look down. When the people look down they will see their houses in Hell. They will be told: You would have been given those had you disobeyed Allah. The people of Paradise will die out of happiness for being saved. Then the people of Hell will be told: O people of Hell! Look above your heads. They will lift their heads and look above. They will be able to see their houses filled with bounties in Paradise. They will be told: You would have been given these had you followed the commands of Allah. The people of Hell will die out of the grief. They will be given their respective houses which they deserved. This is the exegesis of the verse of Allah, in which He says: These are they who are the heirs. Who shall inherit the Paradise; they shall be the heirs. Who shall inherit the Paradise; they shall be the heirs. Who shall inherit the Paradise; they shall be the heirs. Who shall inherit the Paradise; they shall abide therein. abide therein.abide therein.abide therein.”
